_comment: Hard-coded Chinese UI labels in the CN build -> English. Each key is matched only as a complete double-quoted string in the app's own code (not language files), everywhere it appears, so code that compares the same label (search tabs, sync bubble) stays consistent. vivo's official English terms from the Global build are used where they exist. XX / YY are placeholders the app fills in. Labels that are also used as data (domain lists, date parsing, lookup keys) are left out or handled in _code.

_code._comment: Exact code snippets (not just strings) for labels that cannot be replaced everywhere.
